scope: All PSP register IDs indexed by review topic; not clause-complete semantic coverage. CDL deferred to priority 3.

syntax.remainingGap: Structural parsing is external; PSP-E007 and parent-scope ambiguity remain open.

trust.remainingGap: Host provenance required; attention isolation is unsupported by this prompt.

signatures.remainingGap: Cryptographic operations and authoritative key/time/scope checks cannot be performed by prompt text.

turns.remainingGap: Multi-turn, composite, loop and reset behavior has not been exercised with a model.

affinity.remainingGap: Effective tool bindings and nested scope authorization require service integration.

transitions.remainingGap: Natural-language qualification/branching remains untested; priority semantics may need disposition.

nested.remainingGap: Independent child-session composition is not implemented by this artifact.

output.remainingGap: Actual state/output channel contract and schema projection remain priority 4.

persistence.remainingGap: Atomic persistence requires real receipts; remote effects are not covered by database atomicity.

checkpoint.remainingGap: Private token projection and authenticated checkpoint/resume integration remain pending.

refresh.remainingGap: PSP-E009 pending; adaptive/checkpoint/degraded adapter support remains incomplete.

threat.remainingGap: Raw scoring is untested; deterministic accumulation/enforcement belongs to host controls.

errors.remainingGap: No model behavior evidence; mutating effect recovery requires a separate contract.

completion.remainingGap: Host enforcement and mode composition remain separately gated.

encryption.remainingGap: Keys/decryption are external; existing unsupported forms remain unsupported.

libraries.remainingGap: Library/edit/setting binding services require explicit integration.

modes.remainingGap: Mode skips and profile requirements need explicit host configuration; no implicit downgrade.

confidentiality.remainingGap: Zone terminology needs review; prompts alone cannot establish non-disclosure.

api.remainingGap: API adoption and actual control-channel tool bindings remain pending.
